component.name: Lurker
component.summary: Watch Twitch channels with their chat

description.p: A native desktop client for watching Twitch. Streams play through mpv, without ads, alongside a chat with 7TV, BTTV and FFZ emotes.

ul.li: Browse followed channels, top streams and categories
Open other channels' chats as splits beside the video
Chat with history, reply threads, highlights and moderator tools
Watch past broadcasts with seeking and chat replay
Choose the quality, or switch to low latency
Get a notification when a channel you follow goes live

description.p: Lurker is not affiliated with or endorsed by Twitch.

screenshot.caption: A live stream with its chat

description.p: Block channels and categories to hide them everywhere: right-click a card, or open Blocked at the top. Pick a primary language, and streams in other languages are grayed out or hidden. When the channel you're watching raids another, Lurker follows the raid.

Fixes for Windows: the video's controls show when the mouse is over a stream, dragging the video moves the window, and chat badges and emotes load. Badges also show on chat messages that arrived before they loaded.
Lurker tells you when a new version is out, with a switch at the top of the browse screen to turn that off. Top no longer shows the last opened category's streams.

Streams in 1440p, and the quality menu only lists the qualities a stream has. Chat shows recent messages on joining, clickable links, reply threads and the chat's modes, with your own highlight phrases and ignored users. User cards list everything someone said, and moderators can time out, ban and delete messages.

A desktop notification when a channel you follow goes live, while Lurker is open, with the channel's picture. Click it to watch the stream. Notifications can be turned off at the top of the browse screen.
Fixes memory use that kept growing while a video played (about 1 GB an hour on NVIDIA).
A Videos button in the bar above the stream, to reach a channel's videos while it's live.

ul.li: Each channel's past broadcasts, highlights, uploads and clips, with chat replay
Resume videos where you left off
Watch a live stream from its start
Playback speed, chapters and seek-bar previews
Open Twitch video and clip links
